title: Jack White · Archbishop Harold Holmes
description: A full procedural chapel revival leading to the hospital coda. CHIMERA performs the sermon and choruses over the separated accompaniment.

characters.name: Archbishop Harold Holmes
characters.role: Preached verse, sung calls and quiet coda

cues.text: Dear friend, if you wanna feel better,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Don't let the devil make you toss this letter.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: If you've been crossed up by hoodoo,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: the voodoo,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: the wizard or the lizard,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You got family trouble, man trouble, woman trouble,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: your life has double trouble.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You're looking for a true friend or a true lover,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: or if you've been living undercover.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Well, I'm coming to your town to break it all down,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: and help you with all of this.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I'm looking to help you find bliss.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: One day, one way, can't miss.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I'm here to tear all the walls down.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: It doesn't matter if it's a large town or a small town.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Just like Joshua and the fabled walls of Jericho.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I'm here to tear down the institution.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: God spoke to me, said, listen to me.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I anoint you with the power that’ll get them all moving.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You agitated, you prayed and meditated,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: you concentrated on getting elevated.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: By sundown Monday, you who come will be blessed with a big money blessing.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You will be doubted by all the unbelievers and all of the deceivers.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: But you must tell seven friends. You must first bring seven friends.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: And don't be selfish and keep this all to yourself. And don't eat shellfish.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Hate is trying to take someone else's love for yourself.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: But I'm here to tell you that love is trying to help someone else.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I realize that you have tried and tried
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: and are just about ready to give up.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: But I got good news for you.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: God has spoken to my mind and told me to tell you
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: to get moving in the right direction for a change.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I'm gonna put you in the fast lane!
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You need to see me right away, so I can fix this up.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You need to see me right away.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You need to see me right away, so I can fix this up.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: You need to see me right about now.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: God has said he’ll open up the windows of heaven,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: and pour out a rich and mighty blessing.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Not on his town or her town, but your town.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Are you ready for the message?
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: I have a special financial blessing that the Lord has placed in your hand.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Now I want you to begin using this blessing
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: on the very first day that you can.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: And if you are suffering a strange sickness,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: or someone is blocking up all of your success,
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: you need to see me right away, so I can fix this up.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Signed and sealed, yours in faith, love and peace.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher

cues.text: Your friend, Archbishop Harold Holmes.
cues.speaker: holmes-preacher
